为何全球关注超级人工智能（连线评论员）: Why Global Attention on Super Artificial Intelligence (Wired Commentary)
曾 毅 中国科学院自动化研究所研究员、北京前瞻人工智能安全与治理研究院院长: Zeng Yi, Researcher at the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Director of the Beijing Prospective Artificial Intelligence Safety and Governance Research Institute
彭飞：回顾2025年，人工智能发展一日千里: Peng Fei: Looking back on 2025, artificial intelligence development has advanced by leaps and bounds.
大家谈到通用人工智能，充满热情，而谈到超级人工智能，则顾虑重重: When people discuss artificial general intelligence, they are full of enthusiasm; but when discussing super artificial intelligence, they are fraught with concerns.
2025年10月以来，一份呼吁暂缓研发超级人工智能的声明，获得全球一大批科学家、: Since October 2025, a statement calling for a pause in super artificial intelligence research has garnered signatures from a large number of global scientists and prominent figures in business and politics.
通用人工智能与超级人工智能到底有什么区别: What exactly is the difference between artificial general intelligence and super artificial intelligence?
曾毅：目前所说的通用人工智能一般指具有高度泛化能力，接近或达到人类智能水平的信息: Zeng Yi: The artificial general intelligence currently referred to generally means an information processing tool with highly generalized capabilities that approaches or achieves the intelligence level of humans, with very broad application prospects.
超级人工智能则是指各方面都超过人类智能水平，且被认为是接近生命的存在: Super artificial intelligence, by contrast, refers to an entity that surpasses human intelligence in all respects and is regarded as approaching life.
我们期望超级人工智能是“超级利他”的，但如果是“超级邪恶”怎么办: We hope super artificial intelligence is 'super altruistic,' but what if it becomes 'super evil'?
有研究发现，当前主流大语言模型在面临被替换的可能时，竟采取欺骗等方式以自保: Research has found that when faced with the possibility of being replaced, current mainstream large language models have even resorted to deception for self-preservation.
通用人工智能尚且如此，更何况超级人工智能: If artificial general intelligence behaves this way, what more can be said about super artificial intelligence?
超级人工智能为何不会遵循这样的规律: Why would super artificial intelligence not follow such a pattern?
曾毅：不能简单把超级人工智能类比为历史上任何一种技术工具: Zeng Yi: We cannot simply draw analogies between super artificial intelligence and any technological tool in history.
如果超级人工智能的目标与人类价值观不一致，即使微小偏差也可能在经能力放大后导致灾: If the objectives of super artificial intelligence are inconsistent with human values, even minor deviations could lead to catastrophic consequences when amplified by its capabilities.
人类的负面行为大量存储在网络数据中，不可避免会被超级人工智能习得，这极大增加了对: Vast amounts of human negative behavior are stored in online data and will inevitably be learned by super artificial intelligence, which greatly increases the risk of alignment failure and loss of control.
因此，在人工智能开发与治理中，时刻都要坚持底线思维，摆脱传统的被动反应、跟进式的: Therefore, in artificial intelligence development and governance, we must always adhere to bottom-line thinking, move away from traditional passive reaction and follow-up models, and practice foresight and forward-looking planning.
曾毅：从基本原则看，安全必须是发展超级人工智能的“第一性原理”，即安全应成为模型: Zeng Yi: From the perspective of basic principles, safety must be the 'first principle' in developing super artificial intelligence, meaning safety should be embedded as a 'gene' in the model—non-deletable, inviolable, and not to be compromised even if it might affect model capabilities.
但从长期看，真正的挑战在于使超级人工智能与人类期望对齐: But in the long term, the real challenge lies in aligning super artificial intelligence with human expectations.
目前采取的基于人类反馈的强化学习——即在人机交互中将人类价值观嵌入人工智能的模式: The current approach based on reinforcement learning from human feedback—embedding human values into artificial intelligence through human-machine interaction—is unlikely to be effective for super artificial intelligence, urgently requiring entirely new ways of thinking and acting.
从最终效果看，由于超级人工智能可能拥有自我意识，更安全的理想图景是使“它”自主产: From the perspective of final outcomes, given that superintelligent artificial intelligence may possess self-awareness, a safer ideal scenario would be to have
确保人工智能从合乎伦理变成拥有道德，才能最大限度降低风险: Ensuring artificial intelligence evolves from being ethical to possessing morality is the key to minimizing risks to the greatest extent.
彭飞：超级人工智能的安全问题具有全球性，一旦出现漏洞、失控，影响是跨越国界的: Peng Fei: The safety issues of superintelligent artificial intelligence are global in nature; once flaws or loss of control occurs, the impact transcends national borders.
而人工智能的全球竞争又非常激烈，无论国家还是企业，都在争先: Moreover, global competition in artificial intelligence is extremely fierce, with both countries and enterprises racing to advance.
一些发达国家在超级人工智能的研发上更是“油门踩到底”: Some developed countries are even "pushing the accelerator to the floor" in the research and development of superintelligent artificial intelligence.
人工智能治理的全球协作有可能吗: Is global cooperation in artificial intelligence governance possible?
曾毅：人类需要避免人工智能的发展演变为“军备竞赛”，其危害性不可估量: Zeng Yi: Humanity needs to avoid the development of artificial intelligence from evolving into an "arms race," whose hazards are incalculable.
创造出世界上第一个超级人工智能也许不需要国际合作，但确保超级人工智能对全人类安全: Creating the world's first superintelligent artificial intelligence may not require international cooperation, but ensuring that superintelligent artificial intelligence is safe and reliable for all humanity, global cooperation is a must.
世界需要一个高效率、有执行力的国际机构，来协调人工智能的治理，以确保安全: The world needs an efficient and effective international institution to coordinate artificial intelligence governance and ensure safety.
2025年8月，联合国大会决定设立“人工智能独立国际科学小组”和“人工智能治理全: In August 2025, the UN General Assembly decided to establish an "Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence" and an "AI Governance Global Dialogue" mechanism to promote sustainable development and bridge the digital divide.
各主权国家作为政策制定和执行的主体，尤其是掌握先进技术的发达国家，更有责任和义务: Sovereign nations, as the main bodies for policy-making and implementation, especially developed nations with advanced technologies, have greater responsibility and obligation to prevent blind development of superintelligent artificial intelligence under conditions of absent rules, which would cause risk spillover.
